description: solver input: boot_pin_locked = peripherals required for booting; pin_map rows [signal, pin, mux] are fixed constants. DRAFT generated by knowledge_extract from the datasheet - boot behaviour is board-dependent, review against the actual board design before use.

POWER_ON_SETTING_STRAPS.role: Section 6.4.5 Power-On Setting: when PWRONSRC (SYS_PWRONOTP[0]) = 0 the SYS_PWRONPIN value is latched from pins PG[7:0] at the low-to-high transition of nRESET. PG[7:6] -> MISCCFG, PG[5:4] -> NPAGESEL, PG[3:2] -> BTSRCSEL (00 = SPI Flash, 01 = SD/eMMC, 10 = NAND Flash, 11 = USB), PG[1] -> BTSRCVOL (boot source IO voltage 3.3V/1.8V), PG[0] -> SECBTDIS (secure boot disable). These pins are sampled as dedicated boot straps at reset and are not listed as strap functions in the pin-mux table.

_review.basis: DTS 無對應節點或未啟用——視為 bootloader/strap 持有,kernel 不碰

QSPI0_SPI_FLASH_BOOT.role: BTSRCSEL = 00 (default): Boot from SPI Flash (SPI-NAND 1-bit mode default, or SPI-NOR 1-bit mode per MISCCFG). Power-On Setting bit QSPI0CKSEL selects QSPI0_CLK frequency (30 MHz / 50 MHz), which ties the SPI-Flash boot interface to QSPI0.

_review.basis: kernel 板 DTS &qspi0 有效啟用,kernel 會驅動 → plan 必帶

SD0_EMMC0_BOOT.role: BTSRCSEL = 01: Boot from SD/eMMC with MISCCFG[0] = 0 selecting SD0/eMMC0 booting (default); MISCCFG[1] selects eMMC 4-bit or 8-bit booting. Power-On Setting bit SD0BKEN also enables SD0 back-up boot.

_review.basis: kernel 板 DTS &sdhci0 有效啟用,kernel 會驅動 → plan 必帶

SD1_EMMC1_BOOT.role: BTSRCSEL = 01: Boot from SD/eMMC with MISCCFG[0] = 1 selecting SD1/eMMC1 booting; MISCCFG[1] selects eMMC 4-bit (default) or 8-bit booting (8-bit uses eMMC1_DAT4..DAT7).

_review.basis: kernel 板 DTS &sdhci1 有效啟用,kernel 會驅動 → plan 必帶

NAND_FLASH_BOOT.role: BTSRCSEL = 10: Boot from NAND Flash. MISCCFG selects the ECC scheme (BCH T12, BCH T24 or no ECC) and NPAGESEL selects the NAND page size (2 KB / 4 KB / 8 KB) for the boot device.

_review.basis: kernel 板 DTS &nand 有效啟用,kernel 會驅動 → plan 必帶

USB_BOOT.role: BTSRCSEL = 11: Boot from USB. NPAGESEL selects USB role and port (USBD booting, USBH port 0 boot or USBH port 1 boot) and MISCCFG selects over-current polarity. USBP0ID always comes from the dedicated pin HSUSB0_ID. The USB boot interface pins (HSUSB0/HSUSB1 and HSUSB0_ID) are dedicated pins and are not present in the provided pin-mux table.

_review.basis: DTS 無對應節點或未啟用——視為 bootloader/strap 持有,kernel 不碰
